# Vendored fixture dependencies

These unmodified crates were downloaded from crates.io using `Cargo.lock` and
`cargo vendor --locked` through the sandbox install forwarder. Cargo's per-file
checksums and package provenance metadata are retained. They are test fixtures,
not new npm dependencies.

| Crate | Version | SPDX license | Upstream |
|---|---|---|---|
| pinocchio | 0.12.0 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/anza-xyz/pinocchio |
| solana-account-view | 3.0.0 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/anza-xyz/solana-sdk |
| solana-address | 2.9.0 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/anza-xyz/solana-sdk |
| solana-define-syscall | 5.4.0 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/anza-xyz/solana-sdk |
| solana-program-error | 3.0.1 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/anza-xyz/solana-sdk |

The package manifests retain the authorship and repository metadata supplied by
the publishers. The Apache 2.0 license text is included in `LICENSE-APACHE`.
